userStories.title: Extend GET run with viewer and starter presentation
userStories.description: As a web client, I want GET /api/workflows/runs/:runId to return viewer_is_starter and starter_display_name, so that the UI can accurately present starter actions vs named teammate read-only states.
acceptanceCriteria: workflowRunDetailSchema in packages/server/src/routes/schemas/workflow.schemas.ts adds required viewer_is_starter: z.boolean() and starter_display_name: z.string().nullable().

GET /api/workflows/runs/:runId route handler in packages/server/src/routes/api.ts resolves requester with resolveAuthContext(c) and sets viewer_is_starter to true only when authenticated requester.userId === run.user_id.

The handler fetches starter display name via userDb.getUserById(run.user_id), trimming non-empty display_name with fallback to run.user_id; a run with user_id === null returns viewer_is_starter: false and starter_display_name: null without DB lookup.
Unit tests in packages/server/src/routes/api.workflow-runs.test.ts cover signed-in starter, teammate, unsigned viewer, starter with no display name, and starter-less run.
OpenAPI schema assertions in api.workflow-runs.test.ts pass and packages/web/src/lib/api.generated.d.ts is regenerated to export the updated WorkflowRunDetail definition.

userStories.title: Add typed Ask answer client
userStories.description: As a web developer, I want a typed answerAskHuman client and error-status helper in packages/web/src/lib/api.ts, so that the frontend can submit Ask answers and inspect HTTP error statuses consistently.
acceptanceCriteria: packages/web/src/lib/api.ts exports types PendingInteraction, AskAnswerBody, and WorkflowRunActionResponse from generated schema components.

answerAskHuman(runId, requestId, body) issues a single POST request to /api/workflows/runs/:runId/ask/:requestId/answer with encodeURIComponent on runId and requestId, JSON content type, and stringified body.

getApiErrorStatus(error: unknown): number | null extracts numeric own or inherited status from an object error without using any assertions, returning null for non-objects, null, or non-numeric status.
Unit tests in packages/web/src/lib/api.ask.test.ts verify URL encoding, headers, payload forwarding, and getApiErrorStatus matrix, passing via bun test src/lib/api.ask.test.ts.

userStories.title: Parse Ask envelopes, answers, and valid drafts
userStories.description: As a frontend developer, I want pure parser, draft-validation, and payload-builder functions for AskHuman envelopes, so that user inputs are validated strictly before submission without runtime Zod imports.
acceptanceCriteria: Create packages/web/src/components/workflows/parse-ask-envelope.ts exporting AskQuestion, AskDraftValue, AskDraft, parseAskEnvelope, parseAskAnswer, isQuestionValid, isAskDraftValid, and draftToAnswerBody.

parseAskEnvelope returns AskQuestion[] in original envelope order for valid envelopes; returns null for non-objects, missing/empty questions, invalid types, missing prompt/selection/options, non-boolean allowOther, or duplicate question IDs.

isQuestionValid and isAskDraftValid enforce single-select (valid option or non-empty trimmed other if allowOther) and multi-select (non-empty array of valid options/trimmed other) rules, requiring all questions in the draft to be valid.
draftToAnswerBody converts a complete valid draft into { answers: Array<{ questionId: string; value: string | string[] }> } in envelope order.
parseAskAnswer decodes strictly either { decline: true } or valid answers array with non-empty questionId and string/string[] values, returning null for invalid or extra-keyed objects.

Unit tests in packages/web/src/components/workflows/parse-ask-envelope.test.ts cover happy paths, malformed envelopes, validity matrix, and answer decoding, passing via bun test src/components/workflows/parse-ask-envelope.test.ts.
userStories.technicalNotes: Follow plan Task 3 (docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-07-answer-ask-legacy-node-room.md:119-159, 578-654). Create parse-ask-envelope.ts and parse-ask-envelope.test.ts. Pure TypeScript, no Zod or @archon/workflows imports.

userStories.title: Add loop-safe placement and generic transcript slots
userStories.description: As a UI architect, I want loop-safe Ask selection and generic transcript extension slots on NodeRoom, so that Ask cards anchor cleanly at matching tool messages without leaking across loop slices or teaching NodeRoom about HITL.
acceptanceCriteria: Create packages/web/src/components/workflows/merge-agent-room-items.ts exporting AgentRoomItem, selectVisibleNodeAskInteractions, and mergeAgentRoomItems.
selectVisibleNodeAskInteractions filters for kind === 'ask', selected nodeId, and status pending|answered in GET order; excludes purged and permission rows.

An Ask matching a tool row in the full transcript is included only when that tool row is in visibleMessages; an unanchored Ask is included only when visibleMessages reaches the end of the full transcript.
mergeAgentRoomItems sorts visible messages by seq, places matching Ask cards immediately after their tool message, and appends remaining unanchored cards at the end.
NodeRoomProps in packages/web/src/components/workflows/NodeRoom.tsx is extended with renderAfterMessage?: (message: WorkflowNodeMessageResponse) => React.ReactNode and renderAtEnd?: React.ReactNode.

NodeRoom renders renderAfterMessage(msg) immediately after msg, renders renderAtEnd after the transcript slice or in place of empty output placeholder, and renders renderAtEnd after the retry button on error.
Tests in packages/web/src/components/workflows/merge-agent-room-items.test.ts and NodeRoom.test.tsx pass with bun test.
userStories.technicalNotes: Follow plan Task 4 (docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-07-answer-ask-legacy-node-room.md:160-202, 655-750). Create merge-agent-room-items.ts and merge-agent-room-items.test.ts; modify NodeRoom.tsx and NodeRoom.test.tsx.

userStories.title: Implement independent Ask mutation and presentation state
userStories.description: As a state architect, I want a per-request mutation controller and card presentation resolver, so that multiple Ask cards maintain independent lifecycles, duplicate submissions are deduplicated, and terminal resume errors are classified.
acceptanceCriteria: Create packages/web/src/components/workflows/ask-answer-controller.ts exporting AskActionState, AskActionStateByRequest, AskAnswerController, and createAskAnswerController.

createAskAnswerController maintains a private in-flight Set<string>; duplicate calls for the same in-flight requestId return immediately without a second POST, while different request IDs can run concurrently.

The controller transitions state to sending before POST, accepted with submitted answer and resolvedAt ISO timestamp upon success, rejected-late for HTTP 409, and error for other exceptions. Success and 409 trigger invalidation, catching and warning on failure without reverting final state.
Create packages/web/src/components/workflows/ask-card-presentation.ts exporting AskCardViewState, AskCardPresentation, and resolveAskCardPresentation.

resolveAskCardPresentation derives viewState (pending, sending, answered, declined, rejected-late, failed-resume), preferring canonical interaction answer over local accepted answer, and retaining rejected-late even after refetch.

failed-resume is selected only when an accepted/canonical answer exists, nodeStatus is 'failed', and nodeError starts with 'Could not resume the AskHuman session'; unrelated node failures remain answered or declined.
Unit tests in packages/web/src/components/workflows/ask-answer-controller.test.ts and ask-card-presentation.test.ts pass with bun test.
userStories.technicalNotes: Follow plan Task 5 (docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-07-answer-ask-legacy-node-room.md:203-277, 751-840). Create ask-answer-controller.ts, ask-answer-controller.test.ts, ask-card-presentation.ts, and ask-card-presentation.test.ts.

userStories.title: Render the accessible Ask card
userStories.description: As an operator, I want accessible, stateful AskCard and InvalidAskCard components, so that I can answer or decline questions inline with clear validation, focus management, named teammate read-only states, and payload disclosure.
acceptanceCriteria: Create packages/web/src/components/workflows/AskCard.tsx exporting AskCard and InvalidAskCard matching the locked component interfaces.

The card renders an accessible form with aria-label='question from agent, N questions', agent header, node ID, elapsed waiting duration, and fieldset legends with radio (single) or checkbox (multi) controls.
When allowOther is true, selecting Other reveals a text input labelled 'Other answer for <prompt>' with aria-required='true'; custom text equal to a listed option does not jump the selected option.
Only the first actionable card with autoFocus=true focuses its first input; non-starter view renders disabled controls, omits Submit/Decline, and displays 'Waiting for <starter> to answer'.

Submit is disabled until the draft is fully valid; submitting calls onSubmit with the ordered answer body; Decline triggers AlertDialog ('Decline this ask?' / 'The agent will be told you declined') and calls onDecline.
Resolved states display question-labelled summaries: Answered ('Answered · by you' for starter, 'Answered' for teammate), Declined, Already answered, or Resume failed stamp with error text.
All valid card states render a 'View payload' disclosure with pretty-printed JSON; InvalidAskCard renders non-interactive role='alert' with 'Invalid Ask payload' and disclosure without form actions.
Unit tests in packages/web/src/components/workflows/AskCard.test.tsx pass with bun test under NODE_ENV=development.
userStories.technicalNotes: Follow plan Task 6 (docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-07-answer-ask-legacy-node-room.md:278-333, 841-945). Create AskCard.tsx and AskCard.test.tsx. Use existing shadcn AlertDialog/Card/Button/Textarea and native inputs.

userStories.title: Integrate Ask cards through the complete legacy run surface
userStories.description: As an operator, I want Ask cards displayed and actionable across Logs, Graph, and Chat doors in the legacy run view, while maintaining isolation for non-agent rooms and the Chat composer.
acceptanceCriteria: WorkflowExecution.tsx exports WorkflowRunQueryData, mapWorkflowRunDetail, and emptyAskActionStates; maps pendingInteractions, viewerIsStarter, starterDisplayName, and runError (string only) from GET run.

WorkflowExecution manages AskActionStateByRequest (reset per run ID), instantiates memoized controller with answerAskHuman and invalidation, renders WorkflowAskChrome beside StatusBadge, and passes mapped props and merged workflow.status.
NodeTranscriptPane.tsx updates refetch interval to poll every 1000ms for pending, running, and paused statuses, stopping only on terminal statuses.
NodeTranscriptPane composes anchored cards via renderAfterMessage and unanchored cards via renderAtEnd; on transcript query error, renders all cards after the Retry UI.
LegacyGraphLogsPane and LegacyNodeRoom thread Ask props only to agent rooms, removing stale isLive props and selecting nodeState from visibleNodeStates.

Integration tests in NodeTranscriptPane.test.tsx, LegacyNodeRoom.test.tsx, LegacyGraphLogsPane.test.tsx, and WorkflowExecution.test.tsx verify three-door room access, loop isolation, named read-only state, transcript error resilience, non-agent room isolation, and composer isolation.
